# Aliasgar Lakkadghat

> AI Engineer & Data Engineer specializing in agentic workflows, LLM pipelines, data platforms, and production-ready ML systems.

## Summary
Aliasgar Lakkadghat is a software engineer based in Mumbai, India. He currently serves as Technical Lead at MPSTME ACM and builds production-grade AI systems, data engineering pipelines, and interactive 3D web applications.

## Featured Projects

- **Walmart Data Engineering Pipeline**: Medallion architecture analytics engineering platform utilizing Databricks, dbt, Airflow, and Power BI.
- **WhatsApp RAG Bot**: Retrieval-augmented conversational assistant connecting knowledge bases with WhatsApp.
- **Spider-Man 3D WebVerse**: Browser-based 3D WebGL interactive multiverse experience with DualSense controller support. (https://webverse.imalibtw.in/)
